keyEvents.text: Goal! Kairat 1, Mjällby 0. Erkin Tapalov (Kairat) left footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Marc Gual following a fast break.
Luís Mata (Kairat) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Kairat. Azamat Tuyakbayev replaces Oiva Jukkola.
Substitution, Mjällby. Áki Samuelsen replaces Romeo Leandersson.
Substitution, Mjällby. Max Nielsen replaces Martin Agnarsson.
Viktor Gustafson (Mjällby) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Kairat. Aleksandr Mrynskiy replaces Erkin Tapalov.
Substitution, Kairat. Ismail Bekbolat replaces Edmilson.
Damir Kasabulat (Kairat) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Kairat. Mansur Birkurmanov replaces Marc Gual.
